preserved_boundaries: ISE-01..07 remain completed_verified with no reopened implementation authority.

Scene, World/Reality, Action/Event, Combat, Character, Creature, Item/Asset, Vehicle, permissions, MAI and AAI remain canonical; synchronization/golden proof may exercise but cannot replace those authorities.
Remote clients cannot turn local presentation/token/camera state into canonical truth without normal owner-domain validation, expected-version/idempotency and GM adjudication where applicable.
Reconnect/rejoin and stale/conflict handling must fail closed rather than overwrite newer authoritative state.
Hidden/GM-only information, protected cardinality and provider secrets remain permission-filtered before network/player/accessibility projection, diagnostics, export or AI context.
Mobile/tablet, keyboard and nonvisual equivalents must preserve consequential information/actions without making the visual canvas the sole authoritative representation.
Large maps, animated assets and audio-disabled operation must preserve deterministic authoritative results; missing/degraded media cannot block play.
The golden proof must use legitimate references/evidence and cannot activate paid providers, redistribute commercial media, embed credentials or imply entitlement.
SSA-01 is the strict successor only after ISE-08 completion; no SSA implementation authority is granted by this selection.
No paid provider activation, unauthorized media redistribution, tester distribution, release or deployment is authorized.
